segments.source: The Characteristic Polynomial
segments.translation: 특성다항식

segments.source: Learn that the eigenvalues of a triangular matrix are the diagonal entries.
segments.translation: 삼각행렬의 고윳값이 대각성분임을 배웁니다.

segments.source: Find all eigenvalues of a matrix using the characteristic polynomial.
segments.translation: 특성다항식을 사용하여 행렬의 모든 고윳값을 구합니다.

segments.source: Learn some strategies for finding the zeros of a polynomial.
segments.translation: 다항식의 영점을 찾는 몇 가지 전략을 배웁니다.

segments.source: Recipe: the characteristic polynomial of a 2\times 2 matrix.
segments.translation: 계산 절차: 2\times 2 행렬의 특성다항식.

segments.source: Vocabulary words: characteristic polynomial, trace.
segments.translation: 용어: 특성다항식, 대각합.

segments.source: In <xref ref="eigenvectors"/> we discussed how to decide whether a given number <m>\lambda</m> is an eigenvalue of a matrix, and if so, how to find all of the associated eigenvectors.
segments.translation: <xref ref="eigenvectors"/>에서는 주어진 수 <m>\lambda</m>가 행렬의 고윳값인지 판정하는 방법과, 고윳값이라면 그에 대응하는 고유벡터를 모두 구하는 방법을 논의했습니다.

segments.source: In this section, we will give a method for computing all of the eigenvalues of a matrix.
segments.translation: 이 절에서는 행렬의 고윳값을 모두 계산하는 방법을 제시합니다.

segments.source: This does not reduce to solving a system of linear equations: indeed, it requires solving a nonlinear equation in one variable, namely, finding the roots of the characteristic polynomial.
segments.translation: 이는 연립일차방정식을 푸는 문제로 귀결되지 않습니다. 실제로 이는 한 변수에 대한 비선형 방정식을 푸는 것, 즉 특성다항식의 근을 구하는 것을 필요로 합니다.

segments.source: Let <m>A</m> be an <m>n\times n</m> matrix.
segments.translation: <m>A</m>를 <m>n\times n</m> 행렬이라고 합시다.

segments.source:
The <term>characteristic polynomial</term> of <m>A</m> is the function <m>f(\lambda)</m> given by
        <me>f(\lambda) = \det(A-\lambda I_n).</me>
segments.translation: <m>A</m>의 <term>특성다항식</term>은 다음과 같이 주어지는 함수 <m>f(\lambda)</m>입니다. <me>f(\lambda) = \det(A-\lambda I_n).</me>

segments.source: We will see <xref ref="charpoly-is-poly">below</xref> that the characteristic polynomial is in fact a polynomial.
segments.translation: 특성다항식이 실제로 다항식이라는 것은 <xref ref="charpoly-is-poly">아래에서</xref> 살펴보겠습니다.

segments.source: Finding the characterestic polynomial means computing the determinant of the matrix <m>A-\lambda I_n</m>, whose entries contain the unknown <m>\lambda</m>.
segments.translation: 특성다항식을 구한다는 것은 성분에 미지수 <m>\lambda</m>가 포함된 행렬 <m>A-\lambda I_n</m>의 행렬식을 계산한다는 뜻입니다.

segments.source:
Find the characteristic polynomial of the matrix
        <me>A = \mat{5 2; 2 1}.</me>
segments.translation: 다음 행렬의 특성다항식을 구하십시오. <me>A = \mat{5 2; 2 1}.</me>

segments.source:
We have
        <me>
          \begin{split}
          f(\lambda) = \det(A - \lambda I_2)
          \amp= \det\left(\mat{5 2; 2 1} - \mat{\lambda, 0; 0 \lambda}\right) \\
          \amp= \det\mat{5-\lambda, 2; 2 1-\lambda} \\
          \amp= (5-\lambda)(1-\lambda) - 2\cdot 2
          = \lambda^2 - 6\lambda + 1.
          \end{split}
        </me>
segments.translation:
다음을 얻습니다. <me>
          \begin{split}
          f(\lambda) = \det(A - \lambda I_2)
          \amp= \det\left(\mat{5 2; 2 1} - \mat{\lambda, 0; 0 \lambda}\right) \\
          \amp= \det\mat{5-\lambda, 2; 2 1-\lambda} \\
          \amp= (5-\lambda)(1-\lambda) - 2\cdot 2
          = \lambda^2 - 6\lambda + 1.
          \end{split}
        </me>

segments.source:
Find the characteristic polynomial of the matrix
        <me>A = \mat{0 6 8; \frac 12 0 0; 0 \frac 12 0}.</me>
segments.translation: 다음 행렬의 특성다항식을 구하십시오. <me>A = \mat{0 6 8; \frac 12 0 0; 0 \frac 12 0}.</me>

segments.source:
We compute the determinant by expanding cofactors along the third column:
        <me>
          \begin{split}
          f(\lambda) = \det(A - \lambda I_3)
          \amp= \det\mat{-\lambda, 6 8; \frac 12 -\lambda, 0; 0 \frac 12 -\lambda} \\
          \amp= 8\left(\frac 14 - 0\cdot-\lambda\right)
          - \lambda\left(\lambda^2 - 6\cdot\frac 12\right) \\
          \amp= -\lambda^3 + 3\lambda + 2.
          \end{split}
        </me>
segments.translation:
셋째 열을 따라 여인수 전개를 하여 행렬식을 계산합니다. <me>
          \begin{split}
          f(\lambda) = \det(A - \lambda I_3)
          \amp= \det\mat{-\lambda, 6 8; \frac 12 -\lambda, 0; 0 \frac 12 -\lambda} \\
          \amp= 8\left(\frac 14 - 0\cdot-\lambda\right)
          - \lambda\left(\lambda^2 - 6\cdot\frac 12\right) \\
          \amp= -\lambda^3 + 3\lambda + 2.
          \end{split}
        </me>

segments.source: The point of the characteristic polynomial is that we can use it to compute eigenvalues.
segments.translation: 특성다항식의 핵심은 이를 이용하여 고윳값을 계산할 수 있다는 점입니다.

segments.source: Eigenvalues are roots of the characteristic polynomial
segments.translation: 고윳값은 특성다항식의 근입니다

segments.source: Let <m>A</m> be an <m>n\times n</m> matrix, and let <m>f(\lambda) = \det(A-\lambda I_n)</m> be its characteristic polynomial.
segments.translation: <m>A</m>를 <m>n\times n</m> 행렬이라 하고, <m>f(\lambda) = \det(A-\lambda I_n)</m>를 그 특성다항식이라고 합시다.

segments.source: Then a number <m>\lambda_0</m> is an eigenvalue of <m>A</m> if and only if <m>f(\lambda_0) = 0</m>.
segments.translation: 그러면 수 <m>\lambda_0</m>가 <m>A</m>의 고윳값일 필요충분조건은 <m>f(\lambda_0) = 0</m>입니다.

segments.source: By the <xref ref="imt-2"/>, the matrix equation <m>(A-\lambda_0 I_n)x=0</m> has a nontrivial solution if and only if <m>\det(A-\lambda_0 I_n) = 0</m>.
segments.translation: <xref ref="imt-2"/>에 의해, 행렬 방정식 <m>(A-\lambda_0 I_n)x=0</m>가 자명하지 않은 해를 가질 필요충분조건은 <m>\det(A-\lambda_0 I_n) = 0</m>입니다.

segments.source:
Therefore,
        <me>
          \begin{split}
          \lambda_0 \text{ is an eigenvalue of } A
          \amp\iff Ax = \lambda_0 x \text{ has a nontrivial solution} \\
          \amp\iff (A-\lambda_0 I_n)x = 0 \text{ has a nontrivial solution} \\
          \amp\iff A - \lambda_0 I_n \text{ is not invertible} \\
          \amp\iff \det(A - \lambda_0 I_n) = 0 \\
          \amp\iff f(\lambda_0) = 0.
          \end{split}
        </me>
segments.translation:
따라서 고윳값과 가역성 사이에 다음 관계가 성립합니다. <me>
          \begin{split}
          \lambda_0 \text{ is an eigenvalue of } A
          \amp\iff Ax = \lambda_0 x \text{ has a nontrivial solution} \\
          \amp\iff (A-\lambda_0 I_n)x = 0 \text{ has a nontrivial solution} \\
          \amp\iff A - \lambda_0 I_n \text{ is not invertible} \\
          \amp\iff \det(A - \lambda_0 I_n) = 0 \\
          \amp\iff f(\lambda_0) = 0.
          \end{split}
        </me>

segments.source: Finding eigenvalues
segments.translation: 고윳값 구하기

segments.source:
Find the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the matrix
        <me>A = \mat{5 2; 2 1}.</me>
segments.translation: 다음 행렬의 고윳값과 고유벡터를 구하십시오. <me>A = \mat{5 2; 2 1}.</me>

segments.source: In the above <xref ref="charpoly-eg-22"/> we computed the characteristic polynomial of <m>A</m> to be <m>f(\lambda) = \lambda^2-6\lambda + 1</m>.
segments.translation: 위의 <xref ref="charpoly-eg-22"/>에서 <m>A</m>의 특성다항식이 <m>f(\lambda) = \lambda^2-6\lambda + 1</m>임을 계산했습니다.

segments.source:
We can solve the equation <m>\lambda^2-6\lambda+1=0</m> using the quadratic formula:
        <me>
          \lambda = \frac{6\pm\sqrt{36-4}}2 = 3\pm 2\sqrt 2.
        </me>
segments.translation:
근의 공식을 사용하여 방정식 <m>\lambda^2-6\lambda+1=0</m>을 풀 수 있습니다. <me>
          \lambda = \frac{6\pm\sqrt{36-4}}2 = 3\pm 2\sqrt 2.
        </me>

segments.source: Therefore, the eigenvalues are <m>3+2\sqrt 2</m> and <m>3-2\sqrt 2</m>.
segments.translation: 따라서 고윳값은 <m>3+2\sqrt 2</m>와 <m>3-2\sqrt 2</m>입니다.

segments.source: To compute the eigenvectors, we solve the homogeneous system of equations <m>(A-\lambda I_2)x=0</m> for each eigenvalue <m>\lambda</m>.
segments.translation: 고유벡터를 계산하기 위해, 각 고윳값 <m>\lambda</m>에 대해 동차 연립방정식 <m>(A-\lambda I_2)x=0</m>을 풉니다.

<m>\lambda=3+2\sqrt 2</m>일 때 다음을 얻습니다. <me>
          \begin{split}
          A-(3+\sqrt 2)I_2 = \amp\mat{2-2\sqrt2 2; 2 -2-2\sqrt2} \\
          \xrightarrow{R_1 = R_1\times(2+2\sqrt2)}\;
          \amp\mat{-4 4+4\sqrt2; 2 -2-2\sqrt2} \\
          \xrightarrow{R_2 = R_2+R_1/2}\;
          \amp\mat{-4 4+4\sqrt2; 0 0} \\
          \xrightarrow{R_1 = R_1 \div -4}\;
          \amp\mat{1 -1-\sqrt2; 0 0}.
          \end{split}
        </me> 일반해의 매개변수 꼴은 <m>x=(1+\sqrt 2)y</m>이므로, <m>(3+2\sqrt 2)</m>-고유공간은 <m>{1+\sqrt 2\choose 1}</m>로 생성되는 직선입니다.

segments.source: We compute in the same way that the <m>(3-2\sqrt 2)</m>-eigenspace is the line spanned by <m>{1-\sqrt 2\choose 1}</m>.
segments.translation: 같은 방법으로 계산하면 <m>(3-2\sqrt 2)</m>-고유공간은 <m>{1-\sqrt 2\choose 1}</m>로 생성되는 직선입니다.

segments.source: The green line is the <m>(3-2\sqrt 2)</m>-eigenspace, and the violet line is the <m>(3+2\sqrt 2)</m>-eigenspace.
segments.translation: 초록색 직선은 <m>(3-2\sqrt 2)</m>-고유공간이고, 보라색 직선은 <m>(3+2\sqrt 2)</m>-고유공간입니다.

segments.source: Finding eigenvalues
segments.translation: 고윳값 구하기

segments.source:
Find the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the matrix
        <me>
          A = \mat{0 6 8; \frac 12 0 0; 0 \frac 12 0}.
        </me>
segments.translation:
다음 행렬의 고윳값과 고유벡터를 구하십시오. <me>
          A = \mat{0 6 8; \frac 12 0 0; 0 \frac 12 0}.
        </me>

segments.source: In the above <xref ref="charpoly-eg-33"/> we computed the characteristic polynomial of <m>A</m> to be <m>f(\lambda) = -\lambda^3+3\lambda+2</m>.
segments.translation: 위의 <xref ref="charpoly-eg-33"/>에서 <m>A</m>의 특성다항식을 계산하여 <m>f(\lambda) = -\lambda^3+3\lambda+2</m>를 얻었습니다.

segments.source: We eyeball that <m>f(2) = -8 + 3\cdot 2 + 2 = 0</m>.
segments.translation: 눈으로 살펴보면 <m>f(2) = -8 + 3\cdot 2 + 2 = 0</m>임을 알 수 있습니다.

segments.source:
Thus <m>\lambda-2</m> divides <m>f(\lambda)</m>; to find the other roots, we perform <url href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polynomial_long_division">polynomial long division</url>:
        <me>
          \frac{-\lambda^3+3\lambda+2}{\lambda-2}
          = -\lambda^2-2\lambda-1 = -(\lambda+1)^2.
        </me>
segments.translation:
따라서 <m>\lambda-2</m>는 <m>f(\lambda)</m>를 나누어떨어지게 합니다. 나머지 근을 구하기 위해 <url href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polynomial_long_division">다항식 나눗셈</url>을 수행합니다. <me>
          \frac{-\lambda^3+3\lambda+2}{\lambda-2}
          = -\lambda^2-2\lambda-1 = -(\lambda+1)^2.
        </me>

segments.source:
Therefore,
        <me>
          f(\lambda) = -(\lambda-2)(\lambda+1)^2,
        </me>
        so the only eigenvalues are <m>\lambda = 2,-1</m>.
segments.translation:
그러므로 <me>
          f(\lambda) = -(\lambda-2)(\lambda+1)^2,
        </me> 고윳값은 <m>\lambda = 2,-1</m>뿐입니다.

segments.source: We compute the <m>2</m>-eigenspace by solving the homogeneous system <m>(A-2I_3)x=0</m>.
segments.translation: 동차 연립방정식 <m>(A-2I_3)x=0</m>을 풀어 <m>2</m>-고유공간을 계산합니다.

segments.source:
We have
        <me>
          A-2I_3 = \mat{-2 6 8; \frac 12 -2 0; 0 \frac 12 -2}
          \quad\xrightarrow{\text{RREF}}\quad
          \mat{1 0 -16; 0 1 -4; 0 0 0}.
        </me>
segments.translation:
다음을 얻습니다. <me>
          A-2I_3 = \mat{-2 6 8; \frac 12 -2 0; 0 \frac 12 -2}
          \quad\xrightarrow{\text{RREF}}\quad
          \mat{1 0 -16; 0 1 -4; 0 0 0}.
        </me>

segments.source:
The parametric form and parametric vector form of the solutions are:
        <me>
          \syseq{x = 16z; y = 4z; z = z}
          \quad\To\quad
          \vec{x y z} = z\vec{16 4 1}.
        </me>
segments.translation:
해의 매개변수 꼴과 매개변수 벡터 꼴은 다음과 같습니다. <me>
          \syseq{x = 16z; y = 4z; z = z}
          \quad\To\quad
          \vec{x y z} = z\vec{16 4 1}.
        </me>

segments.source:
Therefore, the <m>2</m>-eigenspace is the line
        <me>
          \Span\left\{\vec{16 4 1}\right\}.
        </me>
segments.translation:
그러므로 <m>2</m>-고유공간은 다음 직선입니다. <me>
          \Span\left\{\vec{16 4 1}\right\}.
        </me>

segments.source: We compute the <m>-1</m>-eigenspace by solving the homogeneous system <m>(A+I_3)x=0</m>.
segments.translation: 동차 연립방정식 <m>(A+I_3)x=0</m>을 풀어 <m>-1</m>-고유공간을 계산합니다.

segments.source:
We have
        <me>
          A+I_3 = \mat{1 6 8; \frac 12 1 0; 0 \frac 12 1}
          \quad\xrightarrow{\text{RREF}}\quad
          \mat{1 0 -4; 0 1 2; 0 0 0}.
        </me>
segments.translation:
다음을 얻습니다. <me>
          A+I_3 = \mat{1 6 8; \frac 12 1 0; 0 \frac 12 1}
          \quad\xrightarrow{\text{RREF}}\quad
          \mat{1 0 -4; 0 1 2; 0 0 0}.
        </me>

segments.source:
The parametric form and parametric vector form of the solutions are:
        <me>
          \syseq{x = 4z; y = -2z; z = z}
          \quad\To\quad
          \vec{x y z} = z\vec{4 -2 1}.
        </me>
segments.translation:
해의 매개변수 꼴과 매개변수 벡터 꼴은 다음과 같습니다. <me>
          \syseq{x = 4z; y = -2z; z = z}
          \quad\To\quad
          \vec{x y z} = z\vec{4 -2 1}.
        </me>

segments.source:
Therefore, the <m>-1</m>-eigenspace is the line
        <me>
          \Span\left\{\vec{4 -2 1}\right\}.
        </me>
segments.translation:
그러므로 <m>-1</m>-고유공간은 다음 직선입니다. <me>
          \Span\left\{\vec{4 -2 1}\right\}.
        </me>

segments.source: The green line is the <m>-1</m>-eigenspace, and the violet line is the <m>2</m>-eigenspace.
segments.translation: 초록색 직선은 <m>-1</m>-고유공간이고, 보라색 직선은 <m>2</m>-고유공간입니다.

segments.source: Form of the characteristic polynomial
segments.translation: 특성다항식의 꼴

segments.source: It is time that we justified the use of the term <q>polynomial.</q>
segments.translation: 이제 <q>다항식</q>이라는 용어를 쓰는 근거를 밝힐 때가 되었습니다.

segments.source: First we need a vocabulary word.
segments.translation: 먼저 용어 하나가 필요합니다.

segments.source: Trace of a matrix
segments.translation: 행렬의 대각합

segments.source: Let <m>A</m> be an <m>n\times n</m> matrix, and let <m>f(\lambda)=\det(A-\lambda I_n)</m> be its characteristic polynomial.
segments.translation: <m>A</m>를 <m>n\times n</m> 행렬이라 하고, <m>f(\lambda)=\det(A-\lambda I_n)</m>를 그 특성다항식이라 합시다.

segments.source: Then <m>f(\lambda)</m> is a polynomial of degree <m>n</m>.
segments.translation: 그러면 <m>f(\lambda)</m>는 <m>n</m>차 다항식입니다.

segments.source:
Moreover, <m>f(\lambda)</m> has the form
        <me>
          f(\lambda) = (-1)^n\lambda^n + (-1)^{n-1}\Tr(A)\lambda^{n-1} + \cdots + \det(A).
        </me>
segments.translation:
또한 <m>f(\lambda)</m>는 다음 꼴입니다. <me>
          f(\lambda) = (-1)^n\lambda^n + (-1)^{n-1}\Tr(A)\lambda^{n-1} + \cdots + \det(A).
        </me>

segments.source: In other words, the coefficient of <m>\lambda^{n-1}</m> is <m>\pm\Tr(A)</m>, and the constant term is <m>\det(A)</m> (the other coefficients are just numbers without names).
segments.translation: 다시 말해, <m>\lambda^{n-1}</m>의 계수는 <m>\pm\Tr(A)</m>이고 상수항은 <m>\det(A)</m>입니다(나머지 계수들은 따로 이름이 없는 수일 뿐입니다).

segments.source:
First we notice that
        <me>
          f(0) = \det(A - 0I_n) = \det(A),
        </me>
        so that the constant term is always <m>\det(A)</m>.
segments.translation:
먼저 <me>
          f(0) = \det(A - 0I_n) = \det(A),
        </me>임에 주목하십시오. 따라서 상수항은 항상 <m>\det(A)</m>입니다.

segments.source: We will prove the rest of the theorem only for <m>2\times 2</m> matrices; the reader is encouraged to complete the proof in general using cofactor expansions.
segments.translation: 정리의 나머지 부분은 <m>2\times 2</m> 행렬에 대해서만 증명하겠습니다. 독자는 여인수 전개를 이용하여 일반적인 경우의 증명을 완성해 보기 바랍니다.

<m>2\times 2</m> 행렬을 <m>A = \smallmat  abcd</m>로 쓸 수 있습니다. 그러면 <me>
          \begin{split}
          f(\lambda) \amp= \det(A-\lambda I_2)
          = \det\mat{a-\lambda, b; c d-\lambda}
          = (a-\lambda)(d-\lambda)-bc \\
          \amp=\lambda^2 - (a+d)\lambda + (ad-bc)
          = \lambda^2 - \Tr(A)\lambda + \det(A).
          \end{split}
        </me>

segments.source: Recipe: The characteristic polynomial of a <m>2\times 2</m> matrix
segments.translation: 계산 절차: <m>2\times 2</m> 행렬의 특성다항식

segments.source:
When <m>n=2</m>, the previous <xref ref="charpoly-is-poly"/> tells us all of the coefficients of the characteristic polynomial:
      <me>
        f(\lambda) = \lambda^2 - \Tr(A)\lambda + \det(A).
      </me>
segments.translation:
<m>n=2</m>일 때, 앞의 <xref ref="charpoly-is-poly"/>는 특성다항식의 모든 계수를 알려 줍니다. <me>
        f(\lambda) = \lambda^2 - \Tr(A)\lambda + \det(A).
      </me>

segments.source: This is generally the fastest way to compute the characteristic polynomial of a <m>2\times 2</m> matrix.
segments.translation: 이는 일반적으로 <m>2\times 2</m> 행렬의 특성다항식을 계산하는 가장 빠른 방법입니다.

segments.source:
Find the characteristic polynomial of the matrix
        <me>
          A = \mat{5 2; 2 1}.
        </me>
segments.translation:
다음 행렬의 특성다항식을 구하십시오. <me>
          A = \mat{5 2; 2 1}.
        </me>

segments.source:
We have
        <me>
          f(\lambda) = \lambda^2 - \Tr(A)\lambda + \det(A)
          = \lambda^2 - (5+1)\lambda + (5\cdot 1-2\cdot 2)
          = \lambda^2 - 6\lambda + 1,
        </me>
        as in the above <xref ref="charpoly-eg-22"/>.
segments.translation:
위의 <xref ref="charpoly-eg-22"/>에서처럼 <me>
          f(\lambda) = \lambda^2 - \Tr(A)\lambda + \det(A)
          = \lambda^2 - (5+1)\lambda + (5\cdot 1-2\cdot 2)
          = \lambda^2 - 6\lambda + 1,
        </me>를 얻습니다.

segments.source: By the above <xref ref="charpoly-is-poly"/>, the characteristic polynomial of an <m>n\times n</m> matrix is a polynomial of degree <m>n</m>.
segments.translation: 위의 <xref ref="charpoly-is-poly"/>에 따라 <m>n\times n</m> 행렬의 특성다항식은 <m>n</m>차 다항식입니다.

segments.source: Since a polynomial of degree <m>n</m> has at most <m>n</m> roots, this gives another proof of the fact that an <m>n\times n</m> matrix has at most <m>n</m> eigenvalues.
segments.translation: <m>n</m>차 다항식은 근을 최대 <m>n</m>개 가지므로, 이로부터 <m>n\times n</m> 행렬이 최대 <m>n</m>개의 고윳값을 가진다는 사실을 다른 방법으로 증명할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: See this <xref ref="evecs-max-nr"/>.
segments.translation: 이 <xref ref="evecs-max-nr"/>을 참조하십시오.

segments.source: Eigenvalues of a triangular matrix
segments.translation: 삼각행렬의 고윳값

segments.source: It is easy to compute the determinant of an upper- or lower-triangular matrix; this makes it easy to find its eigenvalues as well.
segments.translation: 상삼각행렬이나 하삼각행렬의 행렬식은 쉽게 계산할 수 있으므로, 그 고윳값도 쉽게 구할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: If <m>A</m> is an upper- or lower-triangular matrix, then the eigenvalues of <m>A</m> are its diagonal entries.
segments.translation: <m>A</m>가 상삼각행렬이거나 하삼각행렬이면, <m>A</m>의 고윳값은 대각성분입니다.

segments.source:
Suppose for simplicity that <m>A</m> is a <m>3\times 3</m> upper-triangular matrix:
          <me>
            A = \mat{a_{11} a_{12} a_{13}; 0 a_{22} a_{23}; 0 0 a_{33}}.
          </me>
segments.translation:
간단히 하기 위해 <m>A</m>가 <m>3\times 3</m> 상삼각행렬이라고 가정합시다. <me>
            A = \mat{a_{11} a_{12} a_{13}; 0 a_{22} a_{23}; 0 0 a_{33}}.
          </me>

segments.source:
Its characteristic polynomial is
          <me>
            f(\lambda) = \det(A-\lambda I_3)
            = \det\mat{a_{11}-\lambda, a_{12} a_{13};
            0 a_{22}-\lambda, a_{23};
            0 0 a_{33}-\lambda}.
          </me>

This is also an upper-triangular matrix, so the determinant is the product of the diagonal entries:
          <me>
            f(\lambda) = (a_{11}-\lambda)(a_{22}-\lambda)(a_{33}-\lambda).
          </me>
segments.translation:
이 행렬도 상삼각행렬이므로, 행렬식은 대각성분의 곱입니다. <me>
            f(\lambda) = (a_{11}-\lambda)(a_{22}-\lambda)(a_{33}-\lambda).
          </me>

segments.source: The zeros of this polynomial are exactly <m>a_{11},\,a_{22},\,a_{33}.</m>

Find the eigenvalues of the matrix
          <me>
            A = \mat{1 7 2 4; 0 1 3 11; 0 0 \pi, 101; 0 0 0 0}.
          </me>
segments.translation:
다음 행렬의 고윳값을 구하십시오. <me>
            A = \mat{1 7 2 4; 0 1 3 11; 0 0 \pi, 101; 0 0 0 0}.
          </me>

segments.source: The eigenvalues are the diagonal entries 1,\pi,0. (The eigenvalue 1 occurs twice, but it counts as one eigenvalue; in we will define the notion of algebraic multiplicity of an eigenvalue.)
segments.translation: 고윳값은 대각성분 1,\pi,0입니다. (고윳값 1은 두 번 나타나지만 하나의 고윳값으로 셉니다. 에서 고윳값의 대수적 중복도 개념을 정의할 것입니다.)

segments.source: Factoring the characteristic polynomial
segments.translation: 특성다항식의 인수분해

segments.source: If <m>A</m> is an <m>n\times n</m> matrix, then the characteristic polynomial <m>f(\lambda)</m> has degree <m>n</m> by the above <xref ref="charpoly-is-poly"/>.
segments.translation: <m>A</m>가 <m>n\times n</m> 행렬이면, 위의 <xref ref="charpoly-is-poly"/>에 따라 특성다항식 <m>f(\lambda)</m>의 차수는 <m>n</m>입니다.

segments.source: When <m>n=2</m>, one can use the quadratic formula to find the roots of <m>f(\lambda)</m>.
segments.translation: <m>n=2</m>일 때는 근의 공식을 사용하여 <m>f(\lambda)</m>의 근을 구할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: There exist algebraic formulas for the roots of <url href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cubic_function#General_solution_to_the_cubic_equation_with_real_coefficients">cubic</url> and <url href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quartic_function#Solving_a_quartic_equation">quartic</url> polynomials, but these are generally too cumbersome to apply by hand.
segments.translation: <url href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cubic_function#General_solution_to_the_cubic_equation_with_real_coefficients">삼차</url> 다항식과 <url href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quartic_function#Solving_a_quartic_equation">사차</url> 다항식의 근에 대해서도 대수적 공식이 존재하지만, 일반적으로 손으로 적용하기에는 너무 번거롭습니다.

segments.source: Even worse, it is known that there is <url href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abel%E2%80%93Ruffini_theorem">no algebraic formula</url> for the roots of a general polynomial of degree at least <m>5</m>.
segments.translation: 더욱이, 차수가 <m>5</m> 이상인 일반적인 다항식의 근에 대해서는 <url href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abel%E2%80%93Ruffini_theorem">대수적 공식이 존재하지 않는다</url>는 사실이 알려져 있습니다.

segments.source: In practice, the roots of the characteristic polynomial are found <url href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Newton%27s_method">numerically by computer</url>.
segments.translation: 실제로는 특성다항식의 근을 <url href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Newton%27s_method">컴퓨터를 이용하여 수치적으로</url> 구합니다.

segments.source: That said, there do exist methods for finding roots by hand.
segments.translation: 그렇기는 하지만, 손으로 근을 구하는 방법도 분명히 존재합니다.

segments.source: For instance, we have the following consequence of the <url href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rational_root_theorem">rational root theorem</url> (which we also call the rational root theorem):
segments.translation: 예를 들어, <url href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rational_root_theorem">유리근 정리</url>로부터 다음과 같은 따름정리를 얻습니다(이것도 유리근 정리라고 부릅니다).

segments.source: Rational Root Theorem
segments.translation: 유리근 정리

segments.source: Suppose that <m>A</m> is an <m>n\times n</m> matrix whose characteristic polynomial <m>f(\lambda)</m> has integer (whole-number) entries.
segments.translation: <m>A</m>가 <m>n\times n</m> 행렬이고, 그 특성다항식 <m>f(\lambda)</m>의 계수가 정수라고 가정합시다.

segments.source: Then all rational roots of its characteristic polynomial are integer divisors of <m>\det(A)</m>.
segments.translation: 그러면 특성다항식의 모든 유리근은 <m>\det(A)</m>의 정수 약수입니다.

segments.source: For example, if <m>A</m> has integer entries, then its characteristic polynomial has integer coefficients.
segments.translation: 예를 들어, <m>A</m>의 성분이 정수이면 그 특성다항식의 계수도 정수입니다.

segments.source: This gives us one way to find a root by hand, if <m>A</m> has an eigenvalue that is a rational number.
segments.translation: 따라서 <m>A</m>가 유리수 고윳값을 가진다면, 이를 이용하여 손으로 근을 하나 구할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Once we have found one root, then we can reduce the degree by <url href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polynomial_long_division">polynomial long division</url>.
segments.translation: 근을 하나 구하고 나면, <url href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polynomial_long_division">다항식 나눗셈</url>으로 차수를 낮출 수 있습니다.

segments.source:
Find the eigenvalues of the matrix
          <me>A = \mat{7 0 3; -3 2 -3; -3 0 -1}.</me>
segments.translation: 다음 행렬의 고윳값을 구하십시오. <me>A = \mat{7 0 3; -3 2 -3; -3 0 -1}.</me>

segments.source: Hint: one eigenvalue is an integer.
segments.translation: 힌트: 고윳값 중 하나는 정수입니다.

segments.source:
We compute the characteristic polynomial by expanding cofactors along the first row:
          <me>
            \begin{split}
            f(\lambda) = \det(A - \lambda I_3)
            \amp= \det\mat{7-\lambda, 0 3; -3 2-\lambda, -3; -3 0 -1-\lambda} \\
            \amp= (7-\lambda)(2-\lambda)(-1-\lambda) + 3\cdot 3(2-\lambda) \\
            \amp= -\lambda^3 + 8\lambda^2 - 14\lambda + 4.
            \end{split}
          </me>
          The determinant of <m>A</m> is the constant term <m>f(0) = 4</m>; its integer divisors are <m>\pm 1,\pm 2,\pm 4</m>.
segments.translation:
첫 번째 행을 따라 여인수 전개를 하여 특성다항식을 계산합니다: <me>
            \begin{split}
            f(\lambda) = \det(A - \lambda I_3)
            \amp= \det\mat{7-\lambda, 0 3; -3 2-\lambda, -3; -3 0 -1-\lambda} \\
            \amp= (7-\lambda)(2-\lambda)(-1-\lambda) + 3\cdot 3(2-\lambda) \\
            \amp= -\lambda^3 + 8\lambda^2 - 14\lambda + 4.
            \end{split}
          </me> <m>A</m>의 행렬식은 상수항 <m>f(0) = 4</m>이며, 그 정수 약수는 <m>\pm 1,\pm 2,\pm 4</m>입니다.

segments.source:
We check which are roots:
          <me>
            f(1) = -3 \quad f(-1) = 27 \quad f(2) = 0 \quad f(-2) = 72 \quad f(4) = 12 \quad f(-4) = 252.
          </me>
segments.translation:
이 중 어느 것이 근인지 확인합니다: <me>
            f(1) = -3 \quad f(-1) = 27 \quad f(2) = 0 \quad f(-2) = 72 \quad f(4) = 12 \quad f(-4) = 252.
          </me>

segments.source: The only rational root of <m>f(\lambda)</m> is <m>\lambda=2</m>.
segments.translation: <m>f(\lambda)</m>의 유일한 유리근은 <m>\lambda=2</m>입니다.

segments.source:
We divide by <m>\lambda-2</m> using polynomial long division:
          <me>
            \frac{-\lambda^3 + 8\lambda^2 - 14\lambda + 4}{\lambda-2} = -\lambda^2 + 6\lambda - 2.
          </me>
segments.translation:
다항식 나눗셈을 사용하여 <m>\lambda-2</m>로 나눕니다: <me>
            \frac{-\lambda^3 + 8\lambda^2 - 14\lambda + 4}{\lambda-2} = -\lambda^2 + 6\lambda - 2.
          </me>

segments.source:
We can use the quadratic formula to find the roots of the quotient:
          <me>
            \lambda = \frac{-6 \pm\sqrt{36 - 4\cdot 2}}{-2}
            = 3\pm\sqrt 7.
          </me>
segments.translation:
근의 공식을 사용하여 몫의 근을 구할 수 있습니다: <me>
            \lambda = \frac{-6 \pm\sqrt{36 - 4\cdot 2}}{-2}
            = 3\pm\sqrt 7.
          </me>

segments.source:
We have factored <m>f</m> completely:
          <me>
            f(\lambda) = -(\lambda-2)\bigl(\lambda-(3+\sqrt7)\bigr)\bigl(\lambda-(3-\sqrt7)\bigr).
          </me>
segments.translation:
이로써 <m>f</m>를 완전히 인수분해하였습니다: <me>
            f(\lambda) = -(\lambda-2)\bigl(\lambda-(3+\sqrt7)\bigr)\bigl(\lambda-(3-\sqrt7)\bigr).
          </me>

segments.source: Therefore, the eigenvalues of <m>A</m> are <m>2,\,3+\sqrt7,\,3-\sqrt7.</m>
segments.translation: 따라서 <m>A</m>의 고윳값은 <m>2,\,3+\sqrt7,\,3-\sqrt7.</m>입니다.

segments.source:
In the above example, we could have expanded cofactors along the second column to obtain
      <me>
        f(\lambda) = (2-\lambda)\det\mat{7-\lambda, 3; -3 -1-\lambda}.
      </me>
segments.translation:
위의 예에서 두 번째 열을 따라 여인수 전개를 하였다면 다음을 얻을 수 있었습니다. <me>
        f(\lambda) = (2-\lambda)\det\mat{7-\lambda, 3; -3 -1-\lambda}.
      </me>

segments.source: Since <m>2-\lambda</m> was the only nonzero entry in its column, this expression already has the <m>2-\lambda</m> term factored out: the rational root theorem was not needed.
segments.translation: <m>2-\lambda</m>가 그 열에서 유일하게 0이 아닌 성분이었으므로, 이 식에는 이미 <m>2-\lambda</m> 항이 인수로 묶여 있습니다. 즉, 유리근 정리가 필요하지 않았습니다.

segments.source:
The determinant in the above expression is the characteristic polynomial of the matrix <m>\smallmat 73{-3}{-1}</m>, so we can compute it using the trace and determinant:
      <me>
        f(\lambda) = (2-\lambda)\bigl(\lambda^2-(7-1)\lambda+(-7+9)\bigr)
        = (2-\lambda)(\lambda^2-6\lambda+2).
      </me>
segments.translation:
위 식의 행렬식은 행렬 <m>\smallmat 73{-3}{-1}</m>의 특성다항식이므로, 대각합과 행렬식을 이용하여 계산할 수 있습니다: <me>
        f(\lambda) = (2-\lambda)\bigl(\lambda^2-(7-1)\lambda+(-7+9)\bigr)
        = (2-\lambda)(\lambda^2-6\lambda+2).
      </me>

segments.source:
Find the eigenvalues of the matrix
          <me>A = \mat{7 0 3; -3 2 -3; 4 2 0}.</me>
segments.translation: 다음 행렬의 고윳값을 구하십시오. <me>A = \mat{7 0 3; -3 2 -3; 4 2 0}.</me>

segments.source:
We compute the characteristic polynomial by expanding cofactors along the first row:
          <me>
            \begin{split}
            f(\lambda) = \det(A - \lambda I_3)
            \amp= \det\mat{7-\lambda, 0 3; -3 2-\lambda, -3; 4 2 -\lambda} \\
            \amp= (7-\lambda)\bigl(-\lambda(2-\lambda)+6\bigr) + 3\bigl(-6-4(2-\lambda)\bigr) \\
            \amp= -\lambda^3 + 9\lambda^2 - 8\lambda.
            \end{split}
          </me>
          The constant term is zero, so <m>A</m> has determinant zero.
segments.translation:
첫 번째 행을 따라 여인수 전개를 하여 특성다항식을 계산합니다: <me>
            \begin{split}
            f(\lambda) = \det(A - \lambda I_3)
            \amp= \det\mat{7-\lambda, 0 3; -3 2-\lambda, -3; 4 2 -\lambda} \\
            \amp= (7-\lambda)\bigl(-\lambda(2-\lambda)+6\bigr) + 3\bigl(-6-4(2-\lambda)\bigr) \\
            \amp= -\lambda^3 + 9\lambda^2 - 8\lambda.
            \end{split}
          </me> 상수항이 0이므로 <m>A</m>의 행렬식은 0입니다.

segments.source:
We factor out <m>\lambda</m>, then eyeball the roots of the quadratic factor:
          <me>
            f(\lambda) = -\lambda(\lambda^2-9\lambda+8) = -\lambda(\lambda-1)(\lambda-8).
          </me>
segments.translation:
<m>\lambda</m>를 인수로 묶은 다음, 이차 인수의 근을 눈으로 찾습니다: <me>
            f(\lambda) = -\lambda(\lambda^2-9\lambda+8) = -\lambda(\lambda-1)(\lambda-8).
          </me>

segments.source: Therefore, the eigenvalues of <m>A</m> are <m>0,1,</m> and <m>8</m>.
segments.translation: 따라서 <m>A</m>의 고윳값은 <m>0,1,</m>과 <m>8</m>입니다.

segments.source: Finding Eigenvalues of a Matrix Larger than <m>2\times 2</m>
segments.translation: <m>2\times 2</m>보다 큰 행렬의 고윳값 구하기

segments.source: Let <m>A</m> be an <m>n\times n</m> matrix.
segments.translation: <m>A</m>를 <m>n\times n</m> 행렬이라고 합시다.

segments.source: Here are some strategies for factoring its characteristic polynomial <m>f(\lambda)</m>.
segments.translation: 다음은 그 특성다항식 <m>f(\lambda)</m>를 인수분해하기 위한 몇 가지 전략입니다.

segments.source: First, you must find one eigenvalue:
segments.translation: 먼저 고윳값 하나를 찾아야 합니다:

segments.source: Do not multiply out the characteristic polynomial if it is already partially factored!
segments.translation: 특성다항식이 이미 부분적으로 인수분해되어 있다면 전개하지 마십시오!

segments.source: This happens if you expand cofactors along the second column in this <xref ref="charpoly-eg-rat-root"/>.
segments.translation: 이 <xref ref="charpoly-eg-rat-root"/>에서 두 번째 열을 따라 여인수 전개를 하면 이러한 경우가 생깁니다.

segments.source: If there is no constant term, you can factor out <m>\lambda</m>, as in this <xref ref="charpoly-eg-0-eval"/>.
segments.translation: 상수항이 없다면, 이 <xref ref="charpoly-eg-0-eval"/>에서처럼 <m>\lambda</m>를 인수로 묶을 수 있습니다.

segments.source: If the matrix is triangular, the roots are the diagonal entries.
segments.translation: 행렬이 삼각행렬이면, 근은 대각성분입니다.

segments.source: Guess one eigenvalue using the <xref ref="rational-root-thm"/>: if <m>\det(A)</m> is an integer, substitute all (positive and negative) divisors of <m>\det(A)</m> into <m>f(\lambda)</m>.
segments.translation: <xref ref="rational-root-thm"/>를 이용하여 고윳값 하나를 추측하십시오: <m>\det(A)</m>가 정수라면, <m>\det(A)</m>의 모든 (양수 및 음수) 약수를 <m>f(\lambda)</m>에 대입하십시오.

segments.source: Find an eigenvalue using the geometry of the matrix.
segments.translation: 행렬의 기하학적 성질을 이용하여 고윳값을 찾으십시오.

segments.source: For instance, a <xref ref="evec-eg-reflection" text="title">reflection</xref> has eigenvalues <m>\pm 1</m>.
segments.translation: 예를 들어, <xref ref="evec-eg-reflection" text="title">반사</xref>는 고윳값 <m>\pm 1</m>을 가집니다.

segments.source: After obtaining an eigenvalue <m>\lambda_1</m>, use <url href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polynomial_long_division">polynomial long division</url> to compute <m>f(\lambda)/(\lambda-\lambda_1)</m>.
segments.translation: 고윳값 <m>\lambda_1</m>을 구한 후, <url href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polynomial_long_division">다항식 나눗셈</url>을 사용하여 <m>f(\lambda)/(\lambda-\lambda_1)</m>을 계산하십시오.

segments.source: This polynomial has lower degree.
segments.translation: 이 다항식은 차수가 더 낮습니다.

segments.source: If <m>n=3</m> then this is a quadratic polynomial, to which you can apply the quadratic formula to find the remaining roots.
segments.translation: <m>n=3</m>이라면 이것은 이차다항식이며, 여기에 근의 공식을 적용하여 나머지 근을 구할 수 있습니다.
